items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a good band. They were playing a music that you could enjoy... They had a good swing. They had a good drummer. It was really a good band.

ctx.x: There was a trombone player that was playing lead. He was a Muslim, I remember. I can’t remember his name, but he played. He really played. He was a jazz player. And there was Purvis Henson, tenor saxophone player.

Yes. He played the trombone really well. There was a good band. They were playing a music that you could enjoy, even if you didn’t know that style of music. You could enjoy it, because they were playing good ensemble work. They had a good swing. They had a good drummer. It was really a good band.
